goal: `mc publish --body-file <path>` puts the file's text in the pull request's body, on the first publish and on an open pull request alike.
`mc merge <repo> <pr> --docs` squashes exactly the head whose file list it checked, and refuses with `drift` when the head moved.

success_criteria.criterion: `run(['--body-file', 'b.md'])` with `deps.read` returning `File body.` creates the pull request with body `File body.` plus the mark, and on an open pull request edits it to that body.
success_criteria.check: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/publish.test.js` passes, including the tests named in step 1.

success_criteria.criterion: `runDocsMerge` calls `gh pr merge <n> --squash --subject … --match-head-commit <headRefOid>`, and stops at `drift` without calling merge when the head read after the mergeability wait differs from the one read with the files.
success_criteria.check: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/docs-merge.test.js` passes, including the tests named in step 2.

steps.title: mc publish --body-file is read
steps.done_when: `src/mc/commands/publish.js` reads `flags['body-file']`; the two new tests in `tests/mc/publish.test.js` pass; `mc gate` is green.
comments: mc publish --body-file now reads flags['body-file'] (scanArgs keys flags without leading dashes); flags.bodyFile was always undefined, so a new pull request took the last commit message as its body. Two tests in tests/mc/publish.test.js cover create and open-PR edit. Plan: success_criteria[0] met.

steps.title: mc merge --docs pins the squash to the head it checked
steps.done_when: `runDocsMerge` passes `--match-head-commit` with the head read beside the file list and stops at `drift` when the head moved; the new tests in `tests/mc/docs-merge.test.js` pass; `mc gate` is green.
comments: runDocsMerge reads headRefOid beside the file list (refusing read when there is none), reads it again after the mergeability wait, refuses drift when it moved, and squashes with --match-head-commit (ruling 43). The archive forge stub in tests/mc/archive-live.test.js and the round-log stub in tests/mc/merge-doc.test.js now answer headRefOid, since the head read is new; docs/technical/mc-merge.md names the new read, drift and the pin.
